groups.name: pendenz.worker
groups.description: Whether this node runs a worker, and how.

groups.name: pendenz.metrics
groups.description: Metrics, used when pendenz-micrometer is on the classpath.

properties.name: pendenz.table
properties.description: The task table, used when the application defines no TaskTable bean.

properties.name: pendenz.id-type
properties.description: The type of the table's id column; fixes the type argument of the Pendenz and PendenzJava beans.

properties.name: pendenz.transaction-manager
properties.description: The transaction manager bean to join, when the application has more than one.

properties.name: pendenz.schema-check
properties.description: Whether startup checks that the task table exists with every column its mapping names.

properties.name: pendenz.worker.enabled
properties.description: Whether this node runs a worker. Off for nodes that only enqueue, and in tests, which call runPending() instead.

properties.name: pendenz.worker.parallelism
properties.description: How many tasks the worker runs at the same time.

properties.name: pendenz.worker.poll-interval
properties.description: How long the worker waits when a poll found no task.

properties.name: pendenz.worker.heartbeat-interval
properties.description: How often a running task refreshes its lock.

properties.name: pendenz.worker.lock-timeout
properties.description: After how long without a heartbeat another worker may take a task over.

properties.name: pendenz.worker.execution-timeout
properties.description: How long a single handler may run before it is cancelled.

properties.name: pendenz.worker.shutdown-timeout
properties.description: How long a stopping worker lets running handlers finish before it cancels them and releases their tasks. Must be below spring.lifecycle.timeout-per-shutdown-phase.

properties.name: pendenz.worker.maintenance-interval
properties.description: How often the worker applies the retention rules of its task types.

properties.name: pendenz.worker.retention-batch-size
properties.description: How many rows one retention statement removes at most.

properties.name: pendenz.worker.notify
properties.description: Wake the worker through LISTEN/NOTIFY instead of waiting for the poll interval. Needs pendenz-postgres-notify and the trigger from PostgresDdl.notifyTrigger.

properties.name: pendenz.metrics.backlog-interval
properties.description: How often the backlog gauges are refreshed. Unset, the default, leaves them off.

values.description: A bigint identity column; the database generates ids.
A uuid column; the client generates random ids.
